ov: Over 2,400 species of predatory insects with big, grasping front legs held folded as if praying. Their closest relatives are termites and cockroaches.

why.p: Mantises are among the insects most commonly kept as pets.

df: Mostly ambush predators of other insects.
fx: Mantises are sometimes mistaken for stick insects and grasshoppers.
_t: Is a Praying Mantis Dangerous? Diet, Size & Quick Facts
